title: New Yorkers brave the cold to welcome Zohran Mamdani as their new mayor
summary: Zohran Mamdani was sworn in as New York City's mayor after his election in November 2025. Mamdani won on his promise to tackle cost-of-living issues in the city while sharply criticising the US president, Republican Donald Trump.
